title: Tooling: 2.07× faster shared-point verify digests with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, `SharedPointCircuit.verify` builds `circuit_sha256` with per-active-node and per-partial-output `json.dumps(..., separators=(',',':'))` updates. Profiling on the historical full-size circuit (`h=46`) shows about half of verify wall time in that JSON encoder path. Open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984) left this object as an explicit next question after shipping mixed-point `scalar_check` digests.

This PR writes the same UTF-8 digest lines with an equivalent hand-rolled formatter (`[node,null,null]`, `[node,[a,b],[common,local]]`, `[common,[t0,t1,t2],node]`), keeps every support and topology assertion, and leaves `circuit_sha256` unchanged. The bit-compression certificate does not list `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` in `source_sha256`.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `SharedPointCircuit(46).verify` (construction excluded; nested `ExclusionCircuit.verify` included) gave median wall time **2.212 → 1.070 seconds (2.07×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every verify receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise (`roles`, `additions`, `merged_additions`, `circuit_sha256`, flags).

Package: `research/shared-point-digest/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/shared-point-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-point-digest
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-digest/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SHARED_POINT_DIGEST verify_cases=5 encoding_cases=8 certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shared-point-digest outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_SHARED_POINT_DIGEST_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Historical support checks use `assert` and are stripped under `-O`; `circuit_sha256` identity remains the gate. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984) (mixed-point `scalar_check`; this package answers its SharedPoint open question), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1874). No competing open PR on the `SharedPointCircuit.verify` digest object at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the shared-point / exclusion circuits and bit-compression screens. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
